data.body: **[P2] Build the testing workspace before importing it.** After a clean `npm ci`, this dependency is linked to the local testing package, whose exports target unbuilt `dist` files. The OTel Jest global setup builds only the core and OTel workspaces, so `npm test` fails resolving this import unless a previous full build happened to populate those files. Add the testing package to `test-setup/build-workspace-candidates.mjs` (or otherwise make the test setup build it) so package-local and clean test runs are self-contained.
